text:
emily (IC): RCA published for the 2026-03-21 serving degradation incident: https://redwood-internal/docs/rca/1916007777-serving-deg. Short TL;DR: simultaneous node preemption during autoscale led to KV cache invalidations + retry storms, which cascaded into model fallbacks and higher p99s. No customer data loss; some clients saw elevated latency for ~18m. Action items and checkpoints are in the doc. :memo:
emily (IC): Highlights: 1) Preventive: add autoscaler guardrail to disallow >30% concurrent scale-in (owner: ian, due 2026-04-07). 2) Recovery: improve fallback prioritization so low-criticality routes are deprioritized (owner: raj, due 2026-04-02). 3) Observability: emit a retry-storm signal and dashboard (owner: maria, due 2026-04-05). 4) Post-incident test: synthetic load + preemption simulation (owner: maria, due 2026-04-09). 5) Runbook update: explicit steps for KV cache warm-up (owner: ops_lead, due 2026-04-03).
emily (IC): Follow-up checkpoints: initial PR reviews by 2026-03-25, infra change canary on dedicated pool 2026-03-30, final sign-off 2026-04-10. Scheduling a 30m check-in Wed 10:00 PT — calendar invite created. @here please ack assigned items or reassign by EOD tomorrow. :bell:
raj (infra): ack — I'll take the fallback prioritization item. I'll open a design doc this afternoon and tag reviewers.
ian (runtime): ack, taking autoscaler guardrail. Quick Q: do we want a hard reject or a staged backoff? I'll propose in the PR.
maria (qa): ack on dashboards + synthetic test. Need one infra hour to seed preemption tests — @raj can you allocate?
raj (infra): yep I can alloc 2h tomorrow. I'll add it to the doc.
jane (support): any customer-facing comms needed? I can draft if so.
emily (IC): we already informed affected customers with a brief note; support team follow-up would be great — please use the template in the RCA and mark any escalations.
sre-bot: calendar invite "RCA follow-up: serving degradation" created for 2026-03-24 17:00 UTC.
ops_lead: added runbook section for KV warm-up, pushed draft to the doc. Needs ops-review.
ian (runtime): quick snippet I'm prototyping for the guardrail in the autoscaler config: ```yaml
scale_in_guardrails:
  max_concurrent_scale_in_percent: 30
  grace_window_seconds: 120
```
emily (IC): nice, once ian opens the PR I'll run the canary on the dedicated pool with load profile B. Maria, please run the synthetic preemption test during that canary window.
maria (qa): will do — I'll post results to the RCA doc and ping this thread.
raj (infra): opened design doc: https://redwood-internal/notes/serving-fallback-prio. Putting reviewers: @ian, @ops_lead, @emily.
ian (runtime): PR opened for autoscaler guardrail: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4287 — tagging reviewers.
emily (IC): thanks everyone. Removing myself from active alerts, monitoring looks stable. We'll reconvene at the check-in — please keep updates in the doc and this thread. :white_check_mark:
jane (support): drafted customer follow-up and shared in the doc, linking to the incident summary.
emily (IC): final note: retrospective takeaway — we need a regular preemption chaos test in our CI matrix. Adding as a separate initiative (ops + runtime).
maria (qa): +1. Creating a ticket and will sync with infra on scope.
ops_lead: added ticket INF-1229 for scheduled preemption tests. ETA Q2 sprint planning.
emily (IC): closing thread for now — ping if you need unblockers. We'll update the doc with progress checkpoints. :lock:
